## What's new

- Search, filter, and copy vault items from the browser popup.
- Browser extensions now match the desktop app.
- Raycast extension available as a standalone source download.

[Install & upgrade](https://github.com/dillionverma/latch#installation). Requires the official Bitwarden CLI. Other formats and checksums are in Assets below.

Preview: macOS is not notarized; Windows is unsigned; Windows and Linux are experimental. Auto-lock defaults to **Never**; change it in Settings.
